instruction: Change the default page margins in LibreOffice Writer to 2.5cm for all sides

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default page margins for LibreOffice Writer to 2.5cm (2500 units in LibreOffice's internal representation). The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file and checks if the margin settings are set correctly. This is similar in complexity to the original task, requiring configuration file modification. Note: LibreOffice stores margins in 1/100th mm units, so 2.5cm = 2500.

llm_judge_reasons: POSITIVE - Getter now implements priority-based path matching (libreoffice.py:48-77) with specific registry paths for application defaults ('/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/Layout/Other', 'StandardPageFormat', 'StandardPageStyle'), addressing concerns about mixing document-specific vs application-default margins.

POSITIVE - Getter collects all four margins from the SAME registry path and returns the highest priority complete margin set (libreoffice.py:101-125), preventing mixing of margins from different configuration scopes.
POSITIVE - Getter includes runtime unit validation with conversion to cm for verification (libreoffice.py:119-123), ensuring extracted values are reasonable (0-10cm range).
POSITIVE - Metric correctly handles expected parameter as direct dictionary access (libreoffice.py:48), which is correct for type='rule' evaluators.
POSITIVE - Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all four required margins (Left, Right, Top, Bottom) matching the instruction requirement for 'all sides'.
MINOR - Postconfig opens and closes LibreOffice Writer to trigger settings persistence (lines 30-63), which should work for most cases but timing (2-3 second sleeps) may be tight on slower systems.

MINOR - Priority path patterns target Writer-specific paths but actual registry structure may vary across LibreOffice versions. The getter will return None if no matching paths found, which is safe but may need adjustment for different versions.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing sleep duration after closing LibreOffice (currently 2 seconds at line 59) to 3-5 seconds to ensure registry file is fully flushed on slower systems.
Consider adding a fallback mechanism if no priority paths match - log detailed warning about which paths were found in the registry file to aid debugging if getter returns None.
